messages:
Jamie R.: quick heads-up — i'll be swapping out Tues AM (UTC) and want to make sure primary/secondary handoff is clear. i'm scheduled primary until 09:00 UTC, then @Devon K. will take primary. i'll be reachable for the first 30m of the shift for shadowing :wave:
Devon K.: got it. what's the canonical checklist for shadow handoffs? any recent incident context i should know about?
Jamie R.: main things: active incidents, pages suppressed, outstanding maintenance windows, and any customer escalations. also note the KV cache regression we saw last week — link to the eval is in the runbook.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Upcoming rotation change for schedule 'infra-oncall' at 09:00 UTC. Primary: Devon K., Secondary: Maria S. Please acknowledge by reacting with :white_check_mark:.
Maria S.: acknowledged. i'll be secondary. fyi i have a customer call at 10:30-11:00 UTC but will be reachable for paging.
Devon K.: acknowledging. can someone drop the quick runbook snippet for paging escalation? want to make sure i know when to escalate to eng-sre.
sre-runbook: Paging escalation steps — brief:
1) Validate page via /alerts overview and check metric spike >3x baseline.
2) Check canary traffic & recent deploys.
3) If latency >1500ms P50 for >2 min AND error rate >2%, escalate to eng-sre and @oncall-manager.
4) If customer-altering, trigger incident channel and call bridge.

sre-runbook: Full runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall/paging-handling (see 'handoff' section for template).
Alex T.: small note — we pushed a config patch that will drain one of the liveness probes at 02:00 UTC recovery job. not expected to affect this window but worth flagging.
Jamie R.: thanks. Devon, when you shadow, i'll walk through the incident bot playbook and the modal commands:
```
/incident status <id>
/incident assign @user
/pager acknowledge
```
Also show you the quick traces: logs -> traces -> type filter: "exec-timeout".
Devon K.: perfect. can we do a 15m overlap call at 08:45 UTC for walk-through?
Jamie R.: yes — i'll schedule a short huddle in the calendar and paste the link here.
Linda P.: tagging in a couple of things from CSE: two customers (ACME, ByteCloud) with elevated latency reports last week. calls with ACME scheduled for Wed PM. not blocking handoff but log it.
Maria S.: noted. if a page comes from ACME product, prioritize routing to the ACME path in the console and include "acme" in the incident title. helps triage.
Jamie R.: added that to the handoff notes. also, gap: we don't have explicit coverage between 02:00-03:00 UTC on weekends if someone is OOO. Devon — are you okay with being flagged for weekend paging during your first two shadow shifts? only if you're comfortable.
Devon K.: i'm fine with one weekend shadow but prefer to opt-out of being primary until after two full shadowed shifts.
Jamie R.: sounds fair. i'll annotate the schedule and ping growth ops to avoid auto-escalating you to primary for the weekend.
oncall-bot: Note: auto-escalation window disabled for user Devon K. for 48h (manual override by Jamie R.).
Alex T.: tiny runbook pointer — if you see KV thrash, run: `scripts/kv/inspect.sh --last 15m` then post output to the incident thread. that speeds diagnosis.
Devon K.: thanks. last q: who owns follow-up post-incident reports (postmortems) for customer-impacting incidents?
Jamie R.: ownership doc: primary oncall owns immediate mitigation and timeline; secondary collates logs; follow-up PM/owner triggers postmortem but oncall will draft the initial timeline. link: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/template
Maria S.: i'll take notes on the first shift with Devon and help with the timeline.
Jamie R.: perfect. schedule link: https://calendar.redwood/shadowing-1809123456 — if anyone else wants to hop in for the overlap huddle, pls join. :thumbsup:
Devon K.: acknowledged and thanks — i'll be on the 08:45h overlap. looking forward to the walkthrough.
Linda P.: adding a reminder — slack status should be set to 'oncall' and phone escalation contact updated.
Jamie R.: done. leaving detailed handoff in the schedule and will DM the pager creds to Devon. thanks everyone — feel free to drop any last-minute notes here. :slightly_smiling_face:
